subject.title: fix(github-copilot): bound Copilot token exchange fetch timeout

question: Should the shared GitHub Copilot token exchange use the existing fixed 30-second provider deadline for all supported public and GHE.com endpoints?
rationale: The patch correctly eliminates an indefinite wait, but selecting when a slow supported credential exchange must fail is an intentional compatibility decision that source inspection and loopback proof cannot settle for every enterprise or proxy deployment.

options.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
options.body: Use the established Copilot OAuth request budget for this shared exchange and accept fail-fast behavior for slower endpoints.

options.title: Require provider calibration
options.body: Hold the PR until provider owners establish a different deadline or retry policy for supported enterprise or proxy deployments.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second deadline
recommendation.body: Use the established Copilot OAuth request budget for this shared exchange and accept fail-fast behavior for slower endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history ties him most closely to the centralized exchange and adjacent Plugin SDK provider policy.
